title: AI News, Monday November 2
desc: Good morning Ryan, and happy Monday, November second! It's Brian, and this is your AI News Station. A weekend's worth of news to get through today: Denmark's public broadcaster opens an AI lab, and a new AI lab opens its doors in Aarhus this very afternoon. Runway lets you swap the actor in a shot while keeping the performance, Kling four point oh shows up everywhere at once, VEED launches lip-synced dubbing as an API, Tencent open-sources a small editing agent that cuts long-form video, and a new image-to-video model goes for half a cent a second. Then Claude's plans get renamed and loosened,
